spans.s:
रेप, अस्, आ, अम्, low, vile, inferior, contemptible;
cruel, savage.
रेप रेप, रेपस्. See p. 846, col. 2.

. fr.
rt. रप्; cf. रपस्), a spot, stain; a wrong or
blamable action, fault, sin; (आस्, आस्, अस्), low, vile,
contemptible; miserly, niggardly; wicked, aban-
doned, cruel, savage.

रेप् रेप्, cl. 1. A. रेपते, &c., to go,
move; to sound.
